# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_workload (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_workload" "example_zero_trust_cws_workload" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  workload_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)

### Optional

- `find_one_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by))
- `workload_id` (String) ID of the workload to retrieve

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String) Optional free-form description.
- `filter` (String) Filter expression selecting the requests this workload matches. Maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
- `id` (String) ID of the workload to retrieve
- `name` (String) Human-readable handle; unique per account.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags attached to this workload
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--find_one_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `find_one_by`

Optional:

- `direction` (String) Sort direction (default: asc)
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `name` (String) Filter by workload name (case-insensitive substring match)
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "name", "created_at", "updated_at".
- `policy_set_id` (String) Filter to workloads attached to this policy set
